hints.title: Median Optimality
hints.text: The median of an array mathematically minimizes the sum of absolute deviations across all elements.

hints.title: Sorting
hints.text: Sort the array and select the middle element as the consensus target value.

hints.title: Deviation Summation
hints.text: Calculate the total absolute difference between every element and the median value.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting to find median followed by linear difference accumulation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating over all possible target integers takes quadratic or unbounded time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Know that the L1 distance minimizer is the median.
